text:
B: Hello. You hear me alright?
A: Er, yeah. Yeah, fine.
B: I'm Abdirahman. Leicester.
A: Gareth. Wrexham.
B: Nice one.
A: Erm. What do you do, then?
B: Vehicle technician. I fix vans at a fleet depot, delivery vans mostly. Servicing, diagnostics, that sort of thing.
A: Oh right. I'm in a transport office, so, er, I'm sort of the other end of it. When a lorry breaks down, I'm the one ringing round to sort another one, you know.
B: Ha. So you're the one shouting at people like me.
A: Nah, I don't really shout. No point. It turns up when it turns up.
B: That's the right attitude, mate. Drivers come in sometimes properly fuming, like it's my fault the van's dead. I just let them get it out, then crack on.
A: Yeah. Same with ours. They're alright if you just leave them be for five minutes.
B: Exactly that.
A: Erm. Actually, while I've got you. My car's MOT. I keep forgetting it. Is it bad if it's, like, a couple of weeks over?
B: Yeah, you don't want that, to be honest. You're not insured properly if it's out, and if you get stopped, that's a fine. Book it this week. Most places'll do you a slot quick. And if anything's dodgy, at least you know about it before it goes wrong on the motorway, you know.
A: Right. Yeah. Kerry's been on at me about it.
B: She's right, mate.
A: Aye, she usually is.
B: I saw a PlayStation pad in your photo. You play FIFA? Well, EA FC now.
A: Yeah. Online, with two mates from school. Most nights, sort of.
B: Same, with my cousins. Who do you play as?
A: Er, Wrexham, mostly. They're not great on it, but, you know. Loyalty, I suppose.
B: Fair play. I just pick whoever's best, to be honest. My cousins hate me for it.
A: Ha. Bit cheap, that.
B: It is, yeah. But I win, so.
A: You a Leicester fan, then?
B: Yeah, Leicester City. Watch it at my cousin's most weekends. Play five-a-side Wednesdays as well, when it doesn't get rained off.
A: I used to play five-a-side. Stopped, ooh, eight years ago, maybe. Knees.
B: You should come back to it. There's lads at ours well older than you, and they're still running about. Well, walking about.
A: Maybe. Dunno, really. I just walk the dog now.
B: What've you got?
A: Staffy. Dot. She ate the remote cable last week.
B: Ha. Proper dog, that. Do you get anything for lunch at work, like, there's a van outside ours does chicken cobs, I'm there every day.
A: Cobs? Oh, baps, yeah. We've got a van does bacon baps on a Friday. Only Fridays, mind. I sort of look forward to it all week, if I'm honest.
B: Bap. Yeah, I've heard that. Never says it like that in Leicester, though.
A: Same thing, isn't it. Bread with something in it.
B: Yeah, exactly. Bread with...
